applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term and job number of the failing change
Change effective date and effective dates of all later bound jobs
What was changed (driver, vehicle/VIN, coverage, named insured)
Exact error text, screenshot, user ID and time with time zone
Whether the job was approved / UW referral cleared; other policies affected?
title: Internal server error during an OOS endorsement
symptoms: Generic 'internal server error' while processing, saving or quoting an OOS endorsement
Error box on save; status error on the job
cause: Unhandled null-pointer or illegal-state errors in custom code that assumes the current slice equals all slices (for example, reading a vehicle that does not exist in a later slice).
diagnosis: Get the server log stack trace by user and timestamp (logging console or Guidewire Cloud Console)
Identify the throwing class and match it against the known-error list
Note the edits in the change and their order
resolution: Split the change into smaller same-date changes
Change the order of edits (remove before add)
If no workaround works, L3 analyses the trace and applies a data fix
workaround: Split or reorder the change as above.
permanent_fix: Null-safe handling for entities that do not exist on every slice, plus a regression test (Problem record).
escalation: PC L3 Policy Transactions when a stack trace points at custom code.
